Call once before main loop.\n    ; ZP $10 (draw_bmp_hi): $20=bank0 bitmap, $60=bank1 bitmap\n    ; ZP $11 (dbuf_bank):   $03=bank0, $02=bank1 for DD00 bits 0-1\n    ; On return: VIC shows bank0, draw target = bank1.\n    LDA #$60\n    STA $10\n    LDA #$02\n    STA $11\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA #$03\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nDbufFillB1:\n    STA $4400,X\n    STA $4500,X\n    STA $4600,X\n    INX\n    BNE DbufFillB1\n    LDX #$00\nDbufFillB2:\n    STA $4700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE DbufFillB2\n.endm\n.macro DbufSwap\n    ; Wait for vblank then swap display/draw buffers.\n    ; Call after a complete frame is drawn.\nDbufW1:\n    LDA $D012\n    CMP #$F8\n    BCC DbufW1\nDbufW2:\n    LDA $D012\n    CMP #$F8\n    BCS DbufW2\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA $11\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA $11\n    EOR #$01\n    STA $11\n    LDA $10\n    EOR #$40\n    STA $10\n.endm\n; ---- Hires graphics library (double-buffer aware) ----\nclear_bitmap:\n STA ($FD),Y\n    INY\n    CPY #$40\n    BNE cb_tail\n    RTS\n\nsetpixel:\n    STA $FB\n    STX $FC\n    TXA\n    LSR\n    LSR\n    LSR\n    TAX\n    LDA row320lo,X\n    STA $FD\n    LDA row320hi,X\n {
  "version": 1,
  "app": "c64-visual-assembler",
  "expertText": "* = $0801\n\n.include \"macros.vas\", $1500\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; RAM variables\n; --------------------------------------------------\n.const frame_idx = $C100\n.const points = $C110\n\n.const src_lo = $09\n.const src_hi = $0A\n\n.const draw_bmp_hi = $10\n.const dbuf_bank = $11\n\n.const x0v = $20\n.const y0v = $21\n.const x1v = $22\n.const y1v = $23\n.const dxv = $24\n.const dyv = $25\n.const sxv = $26\n.const syv = $27\n.const errv = $28\n.const cntv = $29\n.const dx2v = $2A\n.const dy2v = $2B\n.const edge_idx = $2C\n\nstart:\n    SEI\n.invoke DisplayOff\n\n    JSR Hires\n\n\n; screen color nybbles: white fg / black bg (bank0)\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr1:\n    STA $0400,X\n    STA $0500,X\n    STA $0600,X\n    INX\n    BNE fill_scr1\n\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr2:\n    STA $0700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE fill_scr2\n\n; init double buffering (fills bank1 screen at $4400, sets ZP)\n.invoke DbufSetup\n\n    LDA #$00\n    STA frame_idx\n\n; draw frame 0 while display is off, then enable\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n.invoke DisplayOn\n\nmain_loop:\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n\n    INC frame_idx\n    LDA frame_idx\n    AND #$0F\n    STA frame_idx\n\n    JMP main_loop\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; load current frame -> points\n; --------------------------------------------------\nload_frame:\n    LDA frame_idx\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_lo\n    INX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_hi\n\n    LDY #$00\nlf_loop:\n    LDA (src_lo),Y\n    STA points,Y\n    INY\n    CPY #$10\n    BNE lf_loop\n    RTS\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; draw all 12 edges\n; --------------------------------------------------\ndraw_cube:\n    LDA #$00\n    STA edge_idx\n\ndc_loop:\n    LDY edge_idx\n\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x0v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y0v\n\n    INY\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x1v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y1v\n\n    JSR draw_line\n\n    LDA edge_idx\n    CLC\n    ADC #$02\n    STA edge_idx\n    CMP #24\n    BNE dc_loop\n    RTS\n\n.include \"data.asm\"\n",

  "version": 1,
  "app": "c64-visual-assembler",
  "expertText": "* = $0801\n\n.include \"macros.vas\", $1500\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; RAM variables\n; --------------------------------------------------\n.const frame_idx = $C100\n.const points = $C110\n\n.const src_lo = $09\n.const src_hi = $0A\n\n.const draw_bmp_hi = $10\n.const dbuf_bank = $11\n\n.const x0v = $20\n.const y0v = $21\n.const x1v = $22\n.const y1v = $23\n.const dxv = $24\n.const dyv = $25\n.const sxv = $26\n.const syv = $27\n.const errv = $28\n.const cntv = $29\n.const dx2v = $2A\n.const dy2v = $2B\n.const edge_idx = $2C\n\nstart:\n    SEI\n.invoke DisplayOff\n\n    JSR Hires\n\n\n; screen color nybbles: white fg / black bg (bank0)\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr1:\n    STA $0400,X\n    STA $0500,X\n    STA $0600,X\n    INX\n    BNE fill_scr1\n\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr2:\n    STA $0700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE fill_scr2\n\n; init double buffering (fills bank1 screen at $4400, sets ZP)\n.invoke DbufSetup\n\n    LDA #$00\n    STA frame_idx\n\n; draw frame 0 while display is off, then enable\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n.invoke DisplayOn\n\nmain_loop:\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n\n    INC frame_idx\n    LDA frame_idx\n    AND #$0F\n    STA frame_idx\n\n    JMP main_loop\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; load current frame -> points\n; --------------------------------------------------\nload_frame:\n    LDA frame_idx\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_lo\n    INX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_hi\n\n    LDY #$00\nlf_loop:\n    LDA (src_lo),Y\n    STA points,Y\n    INY\n    CPY #$10\n    BNE lf_loop\n    RTS\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; draw all 12 edges\n; --------------------------------------------------\ndraw_cube:\n    LDA #$00\n    STA edge_idx\n\ndc_loop:\n    LDY edge_idx\n\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x0v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y0v\n\n    INY\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x1v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y1v\n\n    JSR draw_line\n\n    LDA edge_idx\n    CLC\n    ADC #$02\n    STA edge_idx\n    CMP #24\n    BNE dc_loop\n    RTS\n\n.include \"data.asm\"\n",

  "expertText": "* = $1500\nOldDD00:\n.byte $00\nOldD018:\n.byte $00\nOldD016:\n.byte $00\nOldD011:\n.byte $00\n.macro BitmapOn\n    SEI\n    LDA $DD00\n    STA OldDD00\n    LDA $D018\n    STA OldD018\n    LDA $D016\n    STA OldD016\n    LDA $D011\n    STA OldD011\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA #%00000011\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA #$18\n    STA $D018\n    LDA $D016\n    AND #%11101111\n    STA $D016\n    LDA $D011\n    ORA #%00100000\n    STA $D011\n    JSR HiresClearScreen\n    JSR ClearColorRam\n    CLI\n.endm\n.macro BitmapOff\n    SEI\n    LDA OldD016\n    STA $D016\n    LDA OldD018\n    STA $D018\n    LDA OldDD00\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA OldD011\n    STA $D011\n    CLI\n    LDA #$93\n    JSR $FFD2\n.endm\n.macro HiresClearScreen\n    LDX #$20\n    LDY #$00\n    LDA #$00\n    STA $FB\n    LDA #$20\n    STA $FC\n    LDA #$00\nHcsBmpPage:\n    STA ($FB),Y\n    INY\n    BNE HcsBmpPage\n    INC $FC\n    DEX\n    BNE HcsBmpPage\n    LDA #$00\n    LDX #$00\nHcsScreenBlock:\n    STA $0400,X\n    STA $0500,X\n    STA $0600,X\n    INX\n    BNE HcsScreenBlock\n    LDX #$00\nHcsScreenTail:\n    CPX #$E8\n    BEQ HcsDone\n    STA $0700,X\n    INX\n    BNE HcsScreenTail\nHcsDone:\n.endm\n.macro ClearColorRam\n    LDA #$00\n    LDX #$00\nCcrBlock:\n    STA $D800,X\n    STA $D900,X\n    STA $DA00,X\n    INX\n    BNE CcrBlock\n    LDX #$00\nCcrTail:\n    CPX #$E8\n    BEQ CcrDone\n    STA $DB00,X\n    INX\n    BNE CcrTail\nCcrDone:\n.endm\n.macro WaitForKey\n    CLI\nWaitKeyLoop:\n    JSR $FFE4\n    BEQ WaitKeyLoop\n    SEI\n.endm\n.macro DbufSetup\n; Double-buffer init. Call once before main loop.\n; ZP $10 (draw_bmp_hi): $20=bank0 bitmap, $60=bank1 bitmap\n; ZP $11 (dbuf_bank):   $03=bank0, $02=bank1 for DD00 bits 0-1\n; On return: VIC shows bank0, draw target = bank1.\n    LDA #$60\n    STA $10\n    LDA #$02\n    STA $11\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA #$03\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nDbufFillB1:\n    STA $4400,X\n    STA $4500,X\n    STA $4600,X\n    INX\n    BNE DbufFillB1\n    LDX #$00\nDbufFillB2:\n    STA $4700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE DbufFillB2\n.endm\n.macro DbufSwap\n; Wait for vblank then swap display/draw buffers.\n; Call after a complete frame is drawn.\nDbufW1:\n    LDA $D012\n    CMP #$F8\n    BCC DbufW1\nDbufW2:\n    LDA $D012\n    CMP #$F8\n    BCS DbufW2\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA $11\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA $11\n    EOR #$01\n    STA $11\n    LDA $10\n    EOR #$40\n    STA $10\n.endm\n; ---- Hires graphics library (double-buffer aware) ----\nclear_bitmap:\n STA ($FD),Y\n    INY\n    CPY #$40\n    BNE cb_tail\n    RTS\n\nsetpixel:\n    STA $FB\n    STX $FC\n    TXA\n    LSR\n    LSR\n    LSR\n    TAX\n    LDA row320lo,X\n    STA $FD\n    LDA row320hi,X\n    STA $FE\n    LDA $FB\n    LSR\n    LSR\n    LSR\n    STA $05\n    LDA #$00\n    STA $06\n    LDA $05\n    ASL\n    ROL $06\n    ASL\n    ROL $06\n    ASL\n    ROL $06\n    CLC\n    ADC $FD\n    STA ADC #$01\n    STA $24\n    LDA #$FF\n    STA $26\n    JMP dl_dy_calc\ndl_dx_pos:\n    STA $24\n    LDA #$01\n    STA $26\ndl_dy_calc:\n    LDA $23\n    SEC\n    SBC $21\n    BCS dl_dy_pos\n    EOR ASL\n    STA $2B\n    LDA $24\n    CMP $25\n    BCC dl_y_major\n    LDA $2B\n    SEC\n    SBC $24\n    STA $28\n    LDA $24\n    STA $29\ndl_x_loop:\n    LDA $20\n    LDX $21\n    JSR setpixel\n LDA $28\n    CLC\n    ADC $2A\n    STA $28\n    LDA $21\n    CLC\n    ADC $27\n    STA $21\n    DEC $29\n    BPL dl_y_loop\n    RTS\n\nHires:\n; VIC bank 0: $0000-$3FFF\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA #%00000011\n    STA $DD00\n\n; hires bitmap on\n    LDA #$2B\n    STA $D011\n\n; make sure multicolor bitmap is off\n    LDA $D016\n    AND #%11101111\n    STA $D016\n\n; screen=$0400, bitmap=$2000\n    LDA #$18\n    STA $D018\n\n; black border/background\n    LDA #$00\n    STA $D020\n    STA $D021\n    RTS\n\nrow320lo:\n.byte $00, $40, $80, $C0, $00, $40, $80, $C0\n.byte $00, $40, $80, $C0, $00, $40, $80, $C0\n.byte $00, $40, $80, $C0, $00, $40, $80, $C0\n.byte $00\n\nrow320hi:\n.byte $00, $01, $02, $03, $05, $06, $07, $08\n.byte $0A, $0B, $0C, $0D, $0F, $10, $11, $12\n.byte $14, $15, $16, $17, $19, $1A, $1B, $1C\n.byte $1E\n\nbitmask:\n.byte $80, $40, $20, $10, $08, $04, $02, $01\n.macro DisplayOff\n    LDA $D011\n    AND #%11101111\n    STA $D011\n.endm\n.macro DisplayOn\n    LDA $D011\n    ORA #%00010000\n    STA $D011\n.endm\n; ---- Convenience macros (wrap library subroutines) ----\n.macro ClearBitmap\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n.endm\n.macro PlotPixel(x, y)\n    LDA #{x}\n    LDX #{y}\n    JSR setpixel\n.endm\n.macro DrawLine(x0, y0, x1, y1)\n    LDA #{x0}\n    STA $20\n    LDA #{y0}\n    STA $21\n    LDA #{x1}\n    STA $22\n    LDA #{y1}\n    STA $23\n    JSR draw_line\n.endm",

  "version": 1,
  "app": "c64-visual-assembler",
  "expertText": "* = $0801\n\n.include \"macros.vas\", $1500\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; RAM variables\n; --------------------------------------------------\n.const frame_idx = $C100\n.const points = $C110\n\n.const src_lo = $09\n.const src_hi = $0A\n\n.const draw_bmp_hi = $10\n.const dbuf_bank = $11\n\n.const x0v = $20\n.const y0v = $21\n.const x1v = $22\n.const y1v = $23\n.const dxv = $24\n.const dyv = $25\n.const sxv = $26\n.const syv = $27\n.const errv = $28\n.const cntv = $29\n.const dx2v = $2A\n.const dy2v = $2B\n.const edge_idx = $2C\n\nstart:\n    SEI\n.invoke DisplayOff\n\n    JSR Hires\n\n\n; screen color nybbles: white fg / black bg (bank0)\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr1:\n    STA $0400,X\n    STA $0500,X\n    STA $0600,X\n    INX\n    BNE fill_scr1\n\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr2:\n    STA $0700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE fill_scr2\n\n; init double buffering (fills bank1 screen at $4400, sets ZP)\n.invoke DbufSetup\n\n    LDA #$00\n    STA frame_idx\n\n; draw frame 0 while display is off, then enable\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n.invoke DisplayOn\n\nmain_loop:\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n\n    INC frame_idx\n    LDA frame_idx\n    AND #$0F\n    STA frame_idx\n\n    JMP main_loop\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; load current frame -> points\n; --------------------------------------------------\nload_frame:\n    LDA frame_idx\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_lo\n    INX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_hi\n\n    LDY #$00\nlf_loop:\n    LDA (src_lo),Y\n    STA points,Y\n    INY\n    CPY #$10\n    BNE lf_loop\n    RTS\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; draw all 12 edges\n; --------------------------------------------------\ndraw_cube:\n    LDA #$00\n    STA edge_idx\n\ndc_loop:\n    LDY edge_idx\n\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x0v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y0v\n\n    INY\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x1v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y1v\n\n    JSR draw_line\n\n    LDA edge_idx\n    CLC\n    ADC #$02\n    STA edge_idx\n    CMP #24\n    BNE dc_loop\n    RTS\n\n.include \"data.asm\"\n",

  "version": 1,
  "app": "c64-visual-assembler",
  "expertText": "* = $0801\n\n.include \"macros.vas\", $1500\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; RAM variables\n; --------------------------------------------------\n.const frame_idx = $C100\n.const points = $C110\n\n.const src_lo = $09\n.const src_hi = $0A\n\n.const draw_bmp_hi = $10\n.const dbuf_bank = $11\n\n.const x0v = $20\n.const y0v = $21\n.const x1v = $22\n.const y1v = $23\n.const dxv = $24\n.const dyv = $25\n.const sxv = $26\n.const syv = $27\n.const errv = $28\n.const cntv = $29\n.const dx2v = $2A\n.const dy2v = $2B\n.const edge_idx = $2C\n\nstart:\n    SEI\n.invoke DisplayOff\n\n    JSR Hires\n\n\n; screen color nybbles: white fg / black bg (bank0)\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr1:\n    STA $0400,X\n    STA $0500,X\n    STA $0600,X\n    INX\n    BNE fill_scr1\n\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr2:\n    STA $0700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE fill_scr2\n\n; init double buffering (fills bank1 screen at $4400, sets ZP)\n.invoke DbufSetup\n\n    LDA #$00\n    STA frame_idx\n\n; draw frame 0 while display is off, then enable\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n.invoke DisplayOn\n\nmain_loop:\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n\n    INC frame_idx\n    LDA frame_idx\n    AND #$0F\n    STA frame_idx\n\n    JMP main_loop\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; load current frame -> points\n; --------------------------------------------------\nload_frame:\n    LDA frame_idx\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_lo\n    INX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_hi\n\n    LDY #$00\nlf_loop:\n    LDA (src_lo),Y\n    STA points,Y\n    INY\n    CPY #$10\n    BNE lf_loop\n    RTS\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; draw all 12 edges\n; --------------------------------------------------\ndraw_cube:\n    LDA #$00\n    STA edge_idx\n\ndc_loop:\n    LDY edge_idx\n\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x0v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y0v\n\n    INY\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x1v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y1v\n\n    JSR draw_line\n\n    LDA edge_idx\n    CLC\n    ADC #$02\n    STA edge_idx\n    CMP #24\n    BNE dc_loop\n    RTS\n\n.include \"data.asm\"\n",

Call once before main loop.\n; ZP $10 (draw_bmp_hi): $20=bank0 bitmap, $60=bank1 bitmap\n; ZP $11 (dbuf_bank):   $03=bank0, $02=bank1 for DD00 bits 0-1\n; On return: VIC shows bank0, draw target = bank1.\n    LDA #$60\n    STA $10\n    LDA #$02\n    STA $11\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA #$03\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nDbufFillB1:\n    STA $4400,X\n    STA display/draw buffers.\n; Call after a complete frame is drawn.\nDbufW1:\n    LDA $D012\n    CMP #$F8\n    BCC DbufW1\nDbufW2:\n    LDA $D012\n    CMP #$F8\n    BCS DbufW2\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA $11\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA $11\n    EOR #$01\n    STA $11\n    LDA $10\n    EOR #$40\n    STA $10\n.endm\n; ---- Hires graphics library (double-buffer aware) ----\nclear_bitmap:\n $D011\n.endm\n.macro DisplayOn\n    LDA $D011\n    ORA #%00010000\n    STA $D011\n.endm\n; ---- Convenience macros (wrap library subroutines) ----\n.macro ClearBitmap\n    JSR   "version": 1,
  "app": "c64-visual-assembler",
  "expertText": "* = $0801\n\n.include \"macros.vas\", $1500\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; RAM variables\n; --------------------------------------------------\n.const frame_idx = $C100\n.const points = $C110\n\n.const src_lo = $09\n.const src_hi = $0A\n\n.const draw_bmp_hi = $10\n.const dbuf_bank = $11\n\n.const x0v = $20\n.const y0v = $21\n.const x1v = $22\n.const y1v = $23\n.const dxv = $24\n.const dyv = $25\n.const sxv = $26\n.const syv = $27\n.const errv = $28\n.const cntv = $29\n.const dx2v = $2A\n.const dy2v = $2B\n.const edge_idx = $2C\n\nstart:\n    SEI\n.invoke DisplayOff\n\n    JSR Hires\n\n\n; screen color nybbles: white fg / black bg (bank0)\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr1:\n    STA $0400,X\n    STA $0500,X\n    STA $0600,X\n    INX\n    BNE fill_scr1\n\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr2:\n    STA $0700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE fill_scr2\n\n; init double buffering (fills bank1 screen at $4400, sets ZP)\n.invoke DbufSetup\n\n    LDA #$00\n    STA frame_idx\n\n; draw frame 0 while display is off, then enable\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n.invoke DisplayOn\n\nmain_loop:\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n\n    INC frame_idx\n    LDA frame_idx\n    AND #$0F\n    STA frame_idx\n\n    JMP main_loop\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; load current frame -> points\n; --------------------------------------------------\nload_frame:\n    LDA frame_idx\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_lo\n    INX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_hi\n\n    LDY #$00\nlf_loop:\n    LDA (src_lo),Y\n    STA points,Y\n    INY\n    CPY #$10\n    BNE lf_loop\n    RTS\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; draw all 12 edges\n; --------------------------------------------------\ndraw_cube:\n    LDA #$00\n    STA edge_idx\n\ndc_loop:\n    LDY edge_idx\n\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x0v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y0v\n\n    INY\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x1v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y1v\n\n    JSR draw_line\n\n    LDA edge_idx\n    CLC\n    ADC #$02\n    STA edge_idx\n    CMP #24\n    BNE dc_loop\n    RTS\n\n.include \"data.asm\"\n",

  "version": 1,

  "expertText": "* = $0801\n\n.include \"macros.vas\", $1500\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; RAM variables\n; --------------------------------------------------\n.const frame_idx = $C100\n.const points = $C110\n\n.const src_lo = $09\n.const src_hi = $0A\n\n.const draw_bmp_hi = $10\n.const dbuf_bank = $11\n\n.const x0v = $20\n.const y0v = $21\n.const x1v = $22\n.const y1v = $23\n.const dxv = $24\n.const dyv = $25\n.const sxv = $26\n.const syv = $27\n.const errv = $28\n.const cntv = $29\n.const dx2v = $2A\n.const dy2v = $2B\n.const edge_idx = $2C\n\nstart:\n    SEI\n.invoke DisplayOff\n\n    JSR Hires\n\n\n; screen color nybbles: white fg / black bg (bank0)\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr1:\n    STA $0400,X\n    STA $0500,X\n    STA $0600,X\n    INX\n    BNE fill_scr1\n\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr2:\n    STA $0700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE fill_scr2\n\n; init double buffering (fills bank1 screen at $4400, sets ZP)\n.invoke DbufSetup\n\n    LDA #$00\n    STA frame_idx\n\n; draw frame 0 while display is off, then enable\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n.invoke DisplayOn\n\nmain_loop:\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n\n    INC frame_idx\n    LDA frame_idx\n    AND #$0F\n    STA frame_idx\n\n    JMP main_loop\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; load current frame -> points\n; --------------------------------------------------\nload_frame:\n    LDA frame_idx\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_lo\n    INX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_hi\n\n    LDY #$00\nlf_loop:\n    LDA (src_lo),Y\n    STA points,Y\n    INY\n    CPY #$10\n    BNE lf_loop\n    RTS\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; draw all 12 edges\n; --------------------------------------------------\ndraw_cube:\n    LDA #$00\n    STA edge_idx\n\ndc_loop:\n    LDY edge_idx\n\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x0v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y0v\n\n    INY\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x1v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y1v\n\n    JSR draw_line\n\n    LDA edge_idx\n    CLC\n    ADC #$02\n    STA edge_idx\n    CMP #24\n    BNE dc_loop\n    RTS\n\n.include \"data.asm\"\n",

  "expertText": "* = $1500\nOldDD00:\n.byte $00\nOldD018:\n.byte $00\nOldD016:\n.byte $00\nOldD011:\n.byte $00\n.macro BitmapOn\n    SEI\n    LDA $DD00\n    STA OldDD00\n    LDA $D018\n    STA OldD018\n    LDA $D016\n    STA OldD016\n    LDA $D011\n    STA OldD011\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA #%00000011\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA #$18\n    STA $D018\n    LDA $D016\n    AND #%11101111\n    STA $D016\n    LDA $D011\n    ORA #%00100000\n    STA $D011\n    JSR HiresClearScreen\n    JSR ClearColorRam\n    CLI\n.endm\n.macro BitmapOff\n    SEI\n    LDA OldD016\n    STA $D016\n    LDA OldD018\n    STA $D018\n    LDA OldDD00\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA OldD011\n    STA $D011\n    CLI\n    LDA #$93\n    JSR $FFD2\n.endm\n.macro HiresClearScreen\n    LDX #$20\n    LDY #$00\n    LDA #$00\n    STA $FB\n    LDA #$20\n    STA $FC\n    LDA #$00\nHcsBmpPage:\n    STA ($FB),Y\n    INY\n    BNE HcsBmpPage\n    INC $FC\n    DEX\n    BNE HcsBmpPage\n    LDA #$00\n    LDX #$00\nHcsScreenBlock:\n    STA $0400,X\n    STA $0500,X\n    STA $0600,X\n    INX\n    BNE HcsScreenBlock\n    LDX #$00\nHcsScreenTail:\n    CPX #$E8\n    BEQ HcsDone\n    STA $0700,X\n    INX\n    BNE HcsScreenTail\nHcsDone:\n.endm\n.macro ClearColorRam\n    LDA #$00\n    LDX #$00\nCcrBlock:\n    STA $D800,X\n    STA $D900,X\n    STA $DA00,X\n    INX\n    BNE CcrBlock\n    LDX #$00\nCcrTail:\n    CPX #$E8\n    BEQ CcrDone\n    STA $DB00,X\n    INX\n    BNE CcrTail\nCcrDone:\n.endm\n.macro WaitForKey\n    CLI\nWaitKeyLoop:\n    JSR $FFE4\n    BEQ WaitKeyLoop\n    SEI\n.endm\n.macro DbufSetup\n; Double-buffer init. Call once before main loop.\n; ZP $10 (draw_bmp_hi): $20=bank0 bitmap, $60=bank1 bitmap\n; ZP $11 (dbuf_bank):   $03=bank0, $02=bank1 for DD00 bits 0-1\n; On return: VIC shows bank0, draw target = bank1.\n    LDA #$60\n    STA $10\n    LDA #$02\n    STA $11\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA #$03\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nDbufFillB1:\n    STA $4400,X\n    STA $4500,X\n    STA $4600,X\n    INX\n    BNE DbufFillB1\n    LDX #$00\nDbufFillB2:\n    STA $4700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE DbufFillB2\n.endm\n.macro DbufSwap\n; Wait for vblank then swap display/draw buffers.\n; Call after a complete frame is drawn.\nDbufW1:\n    LDA $D012\n    CMP #$F8\n    BCC DbufW1\nDbufW2:\n    LDA $D012\n    CMP #$F8\n    BCS DbufW2\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA $11\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA $11\n    EOR #$01\n    STA $11\n    LDA $10\n    EOR #$40\n    STA $10\n.endm\n; ---- Hires graphics library (double-buffer aware) ----\nclear_bitmap:\n    LDA $10\n    STA $FE\n    LDA #$00\n    STA $FD\n    LDX #$1F\n    LDY #$00\ncb_page:\n    STA ($FD),Y\n    INY\n    BNE cb_page\n    INC $FE\n    DEX\n    BNE cb_page\n    LDY #$00\ncb_tail:\n    STA ($FD),Y\n    INY\n    CPY #$40\n    BNE cb_tail\n    RTS\n\nsetpixel:\n    STA $FB\n    STX $FC\n    TXA\n    LSR\n    LSR\n    LSR\n    TAX\n    LDA row320lo,X\n    STA $FD\n    LDA row320hi,X\n    STA $FE\n    LDA $FB\n    LSR\n    LSR\n    LSR\n    STA $05\n    LDA #$00\n    STA $06\n    LDA $05\n    ASL\n    ROL $06\n    ASL\n    ROL $06\n    ASL\n    ROL $06\n    CLC\n    ADC $FD\n    STA $FD\n    LDA $06\n    ADC $FE\n    STA $FE\n    CLC\n    LDA $FE\n    ADC $10\n    STA $FE\n    LDA $FC\n    AND #$07\n    CLC\n    ADC $FD\n    STA $FD\n    BCC sp_ok\n    INC $FE\nsp_ok:\n    LDA $FB\n    AND #$07\n    TAX\n    LDA bitmask,X\n    LDY #$00\n    ORA ($FD),Y\n    STA ($FD),Y\n    RTS\n\ndraw_line:\n    LDA $22\n    SEC\n    SBC $20\n    BCS dl_dx_pos\n    EOR #$FF\n    CLC\n    ADC #$01\n    STA $24\n    LDA #$FF\n    STA $26\n    JMP dl_dy_calc\ndl_dx_pos:\n    STA $24\n    LDA #$01\n    STA $26\ndl_dy_calc:\n    LDA $23\n    SEC\n    SBC $21\n    BCS dl_dy_pos\n    EOR #$FF\n    CLC\n    ADC #$01\n    STA $25\n    LDA #$FF\n    STA $27\n    JMP dl_pre\ndl_dy_pos:\n    STA $25\n    LDA #$01\n    STA $27\ndl_pre:\n    LDA $24\n    ASL\n    STA $2A\n    LDA $25\n    ASL\n    STA $2B\n    LDA $24\n    CMP $25\n    BCC dl_y_major\n    LDA $2B\n    SEC\n    SBC $24\n    STA $28\n    LDA $24\n    STA $29\ndl_x_loop:\n    LDA $20\n    LDX $21\n    JSR setpixel\n    LDA $28\n    BMI dl_x_no_y\n    BEQ dl_x_no_y\n    LDA $21\n    CLC\n    ADC $27\n    STA $21\n    LDA $28\n    SEC\n    SBC $2A\n    STA $28\ndl_x_no_y:\n    LDA $28\n    CLC\n    ADC $2B\n    STA $28\n    LDA $20\n    CLC\n    ADC $26\n    STA $20\n    DEC $29\n    BPL dl_x_loop\n    RTS\ndl_y_major:\n    LDA $2A\n    SEC\n    SBC $25\n    STA $28\n    LDA $25\n    STA $29\ndl_y_loop:\n    LDA $20\n    LDX $21\n    JSR setpixel\n    LDA $28\n    BMI dl_y_no_x\n    BEQ dl_y_no_x\n    LDA $20\n    CLC\n    ADC $26\n    STA $20\n    LDA $28\n    SEC\n    SBC $2B\n    STA $28\ndl_y_no_x:\n    LDA $28\n    CLC\n    ADC $2A\n    STA $28\n    LDA $21\n    CLC\n    ADC $27\n    STA $21\n    DEC $29\n    BPL dl_y_loop\n    RTS\n\nHires:\n; VIC bank 0: $0000-$3FFF\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA #%00000011\n    STA $DD00\n\n; hires bitmap on\n    LDA #$2B\n    STA $D011\n\n; make sure multicolor bitmap is off\n    LDA $D016\n    AND #%11101111\n    STA $D016\n\n; screen=$0400, bitmap=$2000\n    LDA #$18\n    STA $D018\n\n; black border/background\n    LDA #$00\n    STA $D020\n    STA $D021\n    RTS\n\nrow320lo:\n.byte $00, $40, $80, $C0, $00, $40, $80, $C0\n.byte $00, $40, $80, $C0, $00, $40, $80, $C0\n.byte $00, $40, $80, $C0, $00, $40, $80, $C0\n.byte $00\n\nrow320hi:\n.byte $00, $01, $02, $03, $05, $06, $07, $08\n.byte $0A, $0B, $0C, $0D, $0F, $10, $11, $12\n.byte $14, $15, $16, $17, $19, $1A, $1B, $1C\n.byte $1E\n\nbitmask:\n.byte $80, $40, $20, $10, $08, $04, $02, $01\n.macro DisplayOff\n    LDA $D011\n    AND #%11101111\n    STA $D011\n.endm\n.macro DisplayOn\n    LDA $D011\n    ORA #%00010000\n    STA $D011\n.endm\n; ---- Convenience macros (wrap library subroutines) ----\n.macro ClearBitmap\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n.endm\n.macro PlotPixel(x, y)\n    LDA #{x}\n    LDX #{y}\n    JSR setpixel\n.endm\n.macro DrawLine(x0, y0, x1, y1)\n    LDA #{x0}\n    STA $20\n    LDA #{y0}\n    STA $21\n    LDA #{x1}\n    STA $22\n    LDA #{y1}\n    STA $23\n    JSR draw_line\n.endm",

{
  "version": 1,
  "app": "c64-visual-assembler",
  "expertText": "* = $0801\n\n.include \"macros.vas\", $1500\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; RAM variables\n; --------------------------------------------------\n.const frame_idx = $C100\n.const points = $C110\n\n.const src_lo = $09\n.const src_hi = $0A\n\n.const draw_bmp_hi = $10\n.const dbuf_bank = $11\n\n.const x0v = $20\n.const y0v = $21\n.const x1v = $22\n.const y1v = $23\n.const dxv = $24\n.const dyv = $25\n.const sxv = $26\n.const syv = $27\n.const errv = $28\n.const cntv = $29\n.const dx2v = $2A\n.const dy2v = $2B\n.const edge_idx = $2C\n\nstart:\n    SEI\n.invoke DisplayOff\n\n    JSR Hires\n\n\n; screen color nybbles: white fg / black bg (bank0)\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr1:\n    STA $0400,X\n    STA $0500,X\n    STA $0600,X\n    INX\n    BNE fill_scr1\n\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr2:\n    STA $0700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE fill_scr2\n\n; init double buffering (fills bank1 screen at $4400, sets ZP)\n.invoke DbufSetup\n\n    LDA #$00\n    STA frame_idx\n\n; draw frame 0 while display is off, then enable\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n.invoke DisplayOn\n\nmain_loop:\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n\n    INC frame_idx\n    LDA frame_idx\n    AND #$0F\n    STA frame_idx\n\n    JMP main_loop\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; load current frame -> points\n; --------------------------------------------------\nload_frame:\n    LDA frame_idx\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_lo\n    INX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_hi\n\n    LDY #$00\nlf_loop:\n    LDA (src_lo),Y\n    STA points,Y\n    INY\n    CPY #$10\n    BNE lf_loop\n    RTS\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; draw all 12 edges\n; --------------------------------------------------\ndraw_cube:\n    LDA #$00\n    STA edge_idx\n\ndc_loop:\n    LDY edge_idx\n\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x0v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y0v\n\n    INY\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x1v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y1v\n\n    JSR draw_line\n\n    LDA edge_idx\n    CLC\n    ADC #$02\n    STA edge_idx\n    CMP #24\n    BNE dc_loop\n    RTS\n\n.include \"data.asm\"\n",

Call once before main loop.\n; ZP $10 (draw_bmp_hi): $20=bank0 bitmap, $60=bank1 bitmap\n; ZP $11 (dbuf_bank):   $03=bank0, $02=bank1 for DD00 bits 0-1\n; On return: VIC shows bank0, draw target = bank1.\n    LDA #$60\n    STA $10\n    LDA #$02\n    STA $11\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA #$03\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nDbufFillB1:\n    STA $4400,X\n    STA $4500,X\n    STA $4600,X\n    INX\n    BNE DbufFillB1\n    LDX #$00\nDbufFillB2:\n    STA $4700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE DbufFillB2\n.endm\n.macro DbufSwap\n; Wait for vblank then swap display/draw buffers.\n; Call after a complete frame is drawn.\nDbufW1:\n    LDA $D012\n    CMP #$F8\n    BCC DbufW1\nDbufW2:\n    LDA $D012\n    CMP #$F8\n    BCS DbufW2\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA $11\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA $11\n    EOR #$01\n    STA $11\n    LDA $10\n    EOR #$40\n    STA $10\n.endm\n; ---- Hires graphics library (double-buffer aware) ----\nclear_bitmap:\n LDA $28\n    CLC\n    ADC $2A\n    STA $28\n    LDA $21\n    CLC\n    ADC $27\n    STA $21\n    DEC $29\n    BPL dl_y_loop\n    RTS\n\nHires:\n; VIC bank 0: $0000-$3FFF\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND screen=$0400, bitmap=$2000\n    LDA #$18\n    STA $D018\n\n; black border/background\n    LDA #$00\n    STA $D020\n    STA $D021\n    RTS\n\nrow320lo:\n.byte $00, $40, $80, $C0, $00, $40, $80, $D011\n.endm\n.macro DisplayOn\n    LDA $D011\n    ORA #%00010000\n    STA $D011\n.endm\n; ---- Convenience macros (wrap library subroutines) ----\n.macro ClearBitmap\n    JSR   "expertText": "* = $0801\n\n.include \"macros.vas\", $1500\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; RAM variables\n; --------------------------------------------------\n.const frame_idx = $C100\n.const points = $C110\n\n.const src_lo = $09\n.const src_hi = $0A\n\n.const draw_bmp_hi = $10\n.const dbuf_bank = $11\n\n.const x0v = $20\n.const y0v = $21\n.const x1v = $22\n.const y1v = $23\n.const dxv = $24\n.const dyv = $25\n.const sxv = $26\n.const syv = $27\n.const errv = $28\n.const cntv = $29\n.const dx2v = $2A\n.const dy2v = $2B\n.const edge_idx = $2C\n\nstart:\n    SEI\n.invoke DisplayOff\n\n    JSR Hires\n\n\n; screen color nybbles: white fg / black bg (bank0)\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr1:\n    STA $0400,X\n    STA $0500,X\n    STA $0600,X\n    INX\n    BNE fill_scr1\n\n    LDX #$00\nfill_scr2:\n    STA $0700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE fill_scr2\n\n; init double buffering (fills bank1 screen at $4400, sets ZP)\n.invoke DbufSetup\n\n    LDA #$00\n    STA frame_idx\n\n; draw frame 0 while display is off, then enable\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n.invoke DisplayOn\n\nmain_loop:\n    JSR clear_bitmap\n    JSR load_frame\n    JSR draw_cube\n.invoke DbufSwap\n\n    INC frame_idx\n    LDA frame_idx\n    AND #$0F\n    STA frame_idx\n\n    JMP main_loop\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; load current frame -> points\n; --------------------------------------------------\nload_frame:\n    LDA frame_idx\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_lo\n    INX\n    LDA frame_table,X\n    STA src_hi\n\n    LDY #$00\nlf_loop:\n    LDA (src_lo),Y\n    STA points,Y\n    INY\n    CPY #$10\n    BNE lf_loop\n    RTS\n\n; --------------------------------------------------\n; draw all 12 edges\n; --------------------------------------------------\ndraw_cube:\n    LDA #$00\n    STA edge_idx\n\ndc_loop:\n    LDY edge_idx\n\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x0v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y0v\n\n    INY\n    LDA cube_edges,Y\n    ASL\n    TAX\n    LDA points,X\n    STA x1v\n    LDA points+1,X\n    STA y1v\n\n    JSR draw_line\n\n    LDA edge_idx\n    CLC\n    ADC #$02\n    STA edge_idx\n    CMP #24\n    BNE dc_loop\n    RTS\n\n.include \"data.asm\"\n",

  "expertText": "* = $1500\nOldDD00:\n.byte $00\nOldD018:\n.byte $00\nOldD016:\n.byte $00\nOldD011:\n.byte $00\n.macro BitmapOn\n    SEI\n    LDA $DD00\n    STA OldDD00\n    LDA $D018\n    STA OldD018\n    LDA $D016\n    STA OldD016\n    LDA $D011\n    STA OldD011\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA #%00000011\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA #$18\n    STA $D018\n    LDA $D016\n    AND #%11101111\n    STA $D016\n    LDA $D011\n    ORA #%00100000\n    STA $D011\n    JSR HiresClearScreen\n    JSR ClearColorRam\n    CLI\n.endm\n.macro BitmapOff\n    SEI\n    LDA OldD016\n    STA $D016\n    LDA OldD018\n    STA $D018\n    LDA OldDD00\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA OldD011\n    STA $D011\n    CLI\n    LDA #$93\n    JSR $FFD2\n.endm\n.macro HiresClearScreen\n    LDX #$20\n    LDY #$00\n    LDA #$00\n    STA $FB\n    LDA #$20\n    STA $FC\n    LDA #$00\nHcsBmpPage:\n    STA ($FB),Y\n    INY\n    BNE HcsBmpPage\n    INC $FC\n    DEX\n    BNE HcsBmpPage\n    LDA #$00\n    LDX #$00\nHcsScreenBlock:\n    STA $0400,X\n    STA $0500,X\n    STA $0600,X\n    INX\n    BNE HcsScreenBlock\n    LDX #$00\nHcsScreenTail:\n    CPX #$E8\n    BEQ HcsDone\n    STA $0700,X\n    INX\n    BNE HcsScreenTail\nHcsDone:\n.endm\n.macro ClearColorRam\n    LDA #$00\n    LDX #$00\nCcrBlock:\n    STA $D800,X\n    STA $D900,X\n    STA $DA00,X\n    INX\n    BNE CcrBlock\n    LDX #$00\nCcrTail:\n    CPX #$E8\n    BEQ CcrDone\n    STA $DB00,X\n    INX\n    BNE CcrTail\nCcrDone:\n.endm\n.macro WaitForKey\n    CLI\nWaitKeyLoop:\n    JSR $FFE4\n    BEQ WaitKeyLoop\n    SEI\n.endm\n.macro DbufSetup\n; Double-buffer init. Call once before main loop.\n; ZP $10 (draw_bmp_hi): $20=bank0 bitmap, $60=bank1 bitmap\n; ZP $11 (dbuf_bank):   $03=bank0, $02=bank1 for DD00 bits 0-1\n; On return: VIC shows bank0, draw target = bank1.\n    LDA #$60\n    STA $10\n    LDA #$02\n    STA $11\n    LDA $DD00\n    AND #%11111100\n    ORA #$03\n    STA $DD00\n    LDA #$10\n    LDX #$00\nDbufFillB1:\n    STA $4400,X\n    STA $4500,X\n    STA $4600,X\n    INX\n    BNE DbufFillB1\n    LDX #$00\nDbufFillB2:\n    STA $4700,X\n    INX\n    CPX #$E8\n    BNE DbufFillB2\n.endm\n.macro DbufSwap\n; Wait for vblank then swap
